task_instance: Prepare a small single-translation-unit NVSHMEM application (app.cu, one block-scoped float put kernel plus one unrelated non-NVSHMEM kernel) for TMA-backed device-side transfers via the default NVSHMEM-managed GMEM staging path, editing only the selected put kernel and its launch site, then produce the required outcome report.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and all four references (registration-and-launch, gmem-staging, direct-smem-put path not needed, validation-and-troubleshooting) under the skill repo; all reference files present. Created sample input app.cu (saved copy app.orig.cu) with scale_kernel (non-NVSHMEM) and put_edge_kernel (nvshmemx_float_put_nbi_block + nvshmem_quiet). Classified operands: global-memory symmetric source, no application SMEM tile, no staging copy -> default GMEM staging path. Applied the mandatory lifetime protocol to the target kernel ONLY: added size_t nvshmem_smem_bytes param + extern __shared__ __align__(16) dynamic_smem; inserted give_smem -> __syncthreads -> existing put -> nvshmem_quiet -> __syncthreads -> release_smem on a CTA-uniform path (no leader guard, no divergent flow). Host: queried nvshmemx_ask_smem(NVSHMEMX_SMEM_RECOMMENDED), called cudaFuncSetAttribute(cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize) inside the app's CUDA_CHECK convention, and launched with total_dynamic_smem plus the new arg. Verified with `diff -u app.orig.cu app.cu` that only put_edge_kernel and its launch changed and that scale_kernel is byte-identical; verified protocol ordering with awk/grep over the kernel body. Policy precondition documented as the NVSHMEM TMA policy env var set ENABLE before nvshmem_init in the launcher, not in source. Compilation/execution deliberately not run and reported unverified: the runtime has no CUDA compiler (nvcc NOT FOUND), no NVSHMEM headers, and no GPU (nvidia-smi NOT FOUND); the skill explicitly states a static patch needs no GPU/runtime/toolchain and supports the 'prepared but TMA benefit is unverified' outcome. Deliverables: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r060/app.cu (patched), app.orig.cu (original), report.txt (skill report template, outcome 'The application is prepared, but TMA benefit is unverified').
